LESSON: WRITING 4.4.1 HANDWRITI NG

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade three
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 4
Topic 4.4: Writing 4.4.1 Handwriti ng
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 4.4.1 Handwriti ng, part of Strand 4 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade three ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why do we write neatly and legibly?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Communication: The learner’s ability to write clearly and correctly is improved as they write words in clear and legible

handwriting.

Values:
Respect is enhanced as the learner works together with peers to write neat and legible sentences.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Life skills (Self-esteem): The learner’s self-esteem is nurtured as their handwriting improves through practise in writing neatly

and legibly.

Links to other Learning Areas:
The learner is able to use the aspects of good handwriting in learning of similar concept in Kiswahili Language Activities.
